text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, while walking Daiwa Scarlet
back to her dorm—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it,
how do you usually spend your days off?"
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-Not really?
I mean, how do I put it—it's just for reference!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling rest is necessary to achieve results.
I'm just exploring better ways to rest!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, well, I thought I'd ask around about how different people take breaks
and see if there's a style that fits me...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It's true!
It really is just for reference, okay!?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
......So, how about it?
What are your days off like?
choice_data_list: It's like spending time being active outdoors.
I guess it's like spending time being active outdoors?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
So that's how it is for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I read manga on my days off too,
so I can kind of understand how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that was helpful.
See you tomorrow, then!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Later, on Daiwa Scarlet's day off,
she suggested watching a movie together in the Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day was lots of fun, serving as a great break for both myself and her.
